title: KMP Across Chunks
statement:
Use KMP to find all occurrences of a pattern in a text supplied in chunks. A match can overlap another match or cross any number of chunk boundaries.

Input
One nonempty lowercase pattern, an integer c, then c nonempty lowercase chunks in order.

Output
Print the number of matches, then the 1-based start positions in the concatenated text in ascending order. Print only 0 if no matches exist.

Constraints
1 ≤ pattern length, c, and total text length ≤ 200000.
